definition.covered: All required command forms and options have independently verified native and reachable GUI evidence. No command currently meets this standard.
definition.partial: A specifically named native task, inspector, delegated task or visible derived-state form is reachable. This never means complete command/options support.
definition.missing: No dedicated native/GUI command contract exists. Equivalent workflows and incidental internal helpers are recorded without counting them as direct coverage.
